map.农药安全间隔期倒计时 使用指南: Pesticide Pre-Harvest Interval Countdown User Guide
map.选择农药并输入施药日期，计算安全采收倒计时（PHI安全间隔期数据仅供参考）: Select a pesticide and enter the application date to compute the pre-harvest countdown (PHI data is reference only)
map.可采日 = 末次施药日 + 安全间隔期（PHI，天）。: Harvest date = last application date + the pre-harvest interval (PHI, in days).
map.不同药剂、作物 PHI 不同（标签注明）。: The PHI differs by pesticide and crop (stated on the label).
map.用于保障农产品残留达标。: Used to keep agricultural product residues within limits.
map.：9 月 1 日喷施某杀虫剂，标签 PHI 7 天，则最早可采日 = 9 月 8: An insecticide is applied on September 1 with a labeled PHI of 7 days, so the earliest harvest date is September 8. If a follow-up spray is needed on September 5, the harvest date slips to September 12 and the clock restarts.
map.种子发芽率与活力指数计算器: Seed Germination Rate and Vigor Index Calculator
map.最后一次施药到作物可安全采收的最短天数，确保残留降解到限量以下。是农药标签的法定: The minimum number of days from the last application until the crop is safe to harvest, ensuring residues degrade below the limit. This is a legal requirement on the pesticide label and violating it risks exceeding the limit.
map.下雨冲掉药要重喷吗？: Do you need to re-spray after rain washes off the pesticide?
map.施药后短时降雨会减效，但是否重喷看药剂与间隔。重喷会延长 PHI，临近采收应谨慎: Brief rain after application reduces effectiveness, but whether to re-spray depends on the product and the interval. Re-spraying extends the PHI, so be careful near harvest and prefer low-risk options.
